pyq.q: Processor needs software interrupt to:
o: Test the interrupt system of the processor
Obtain system services which need execution of privileged instructions
pyq.e: A software interrupt is a deliberate call into the OS, used when a program needs a service only the OS may perform, such as I/O. Software interrupt = system call; hardware interrupt comes from a device.

pyq.q:
Consider Column - 1 and Column - 2 :
Column-I | Column-II
I. Microsoft Office | A. File Archiver and Compressor
II. Windows-10 | B. Digital Library
III. WinZip | C. Application Software
IV. A. V. G | D. Operating System
V. N. D. L. I. | E. Antivirus
Match of Column-1 and Column-2 is :
pyq.e: Microsoft Office is application software, Windows-10 an OS, WinZip an archiver, AVG antivirus and NDLI the National Digital Library of India: I-C, II-D, III-A, IV-E, V-B.

pyq.q: What is the value of F̅? F = AB + C̅D̅ + B̅ D
pyq.e: Complement with De Morgan: F̅ = (AB)′·(C̅D̅)′·(B̅D)′ = (A̅ + B̅)(C + D)(B + D̅), option (b).

pyq.q:
What is the meaning of this arithmetic micro-operation?
R3 ← R1 + R̅2 + 1
o: Content of R1 plus R2 transferred to R3
Content of R1 plus the 2’s complement of R2 transferred to R3
Content of R1 plus the 1’s complement of R2 transferred to R3
Content of R1 plus R2 after increments transferred to R3
pyq.e: R̅2 is the 1's complement of R2 and adding 1 makes it the 2's complement, so R3 ← R1 − R2.

pyq.q: Which of the following is correct for Digital Circuits?
o: They use analog signals for communication
They process information using continuous voltage levels
They are not suitable for high speed operations
More than one of the above
pyq.e: Digital circuits use discrete 0/1 levels and are used in the fastest devices, so (a), (b), (c) are false, hence (d) is false too; the answer is (e).

pyq.q: A computer system has 7 tape drives. There are ‘n’ processes competing for them. Each process may need 3 tape drives. What is the maximum value of ‘n’ for which the system is guaranteed to be deadlock free?
pyq.e: Deadlock-free if n(k−1)+1 ≤ R, i.e. 2n+1 ≤ 7, so n ≤ 3. With n = 4 all 7 drives can be held with every process waiting.

pyq.q:
Assume that the following jobs are to be executed on a single processor system. All jobs have arrived at 0 msec.
Job Id | CPU
a | 4
b | 1
c | 7
d | 2
If scheduling is round robin with time slice 1 msec, then what is the completion time for job ‘a’?
pyq.e: Gantt: a b c d a c d a c a (1 ms each); job a's 4th slice is 9–10, so it completes at 10 ms.

pyq.q: Consider a set of n tasks with known run times r1, r2, ......, rn to be run on a uniprocessor machine. Which of the following processor scheduling algorithms will result in the maximum throughput?
pyq.e: Shortest Job First picks the smallest task each time, finishing the most tasks per unit time (and minimum average waiting time).

pyq.q: Turnaround time in operating systems is
o: The sum of periods spent in waiting to get into memory, waiting in the ready queue, executing on the CPU, and doing I/O.
The amount of time a job spends waiting in the ready queue.
The time from the submission of a request until the first response is produced.
The amount of time spent waiting in the device queue.
pyq.e: Turnaround time is the total elapsed time from submission to completion, including memory wait, ready queue wait, CPU execution and I/O.

pyq.q: ______ systems have well defined fixed time constraints on processing of special events.
pyq.e: Real-time operating systems have well-defined fixed time constraints; a result after the deadline is worthless.

pyq.q: What will be the output of the Linux shell command 'rm doc*'?
o: Erase all files beginning with the pattern 'doc'
Erase all files ending with the pattern 'doc'
List filenames ending with the pattern 'doc'
List filenames beginning with the pattern 'doc'
pyq.e: rm deletes files, and the wildcard * matches every name beginning with 'doc'.

pyq.q:
Consider a system with ten units of resource R and three processes: X, Y, and Z. The maximum resource requirement and current allocation to these processes are as follows:
 | X | Y | Z
Maximum Resource Requirement | 8 | 7 | 5
Current Allocation | 4 | 1 | 3
Now, consider the following resource requests: (i) X makes a request for 2 resource units (ii) Y makes a request for 2 resource units (iii) Z makes a request for 2 resource units For the system to be in safe state, which of the following must be granted?
o: Only requests (i) and (ii) must be granted
Only request (i) and (iii) must be granted
pyq.e: Two units are free; remaining needs are X 4, Y 6, Z 2. Granting Z lets it finish and release 5 units, so X and Y can finish; granting X or Y leaves nothing free and is unsafe.
The outer loop runs 3 times and the inner 2 times each, so the innermost body executes 3×2 = 6 times.

pyq.e: a4 = 10000; follows break with no case label, so no path can reach it (dead code).

o: It belongs to both the if statements.
pyq.e: An else binds to the nearest unmatched if (dangling else), so it belongs to if #2.

Sets Z to be the value of Y

pyq.q: Which of the following is a pillar of OOP?
o: More than one of the above
pyq.e: Inheritance, encapsulation and abstraction (and polymorphism) are all pillars of OOP, so more than one is correct.

pyq.q: Which of the following file stream function will move the file pointer to Nth record in a binary file F created with the help of objects of class EMP ?
pyq.e: To reach the N-th record skip N−1 records of sizeof(EMP) bytes each: offset = (N−1)×sizeof(EMP).
x << 4 = 1024; casting to byte keeps the low 8 bits, which are all zero, so y = 0.

pyq.q: Which of the following is/are feature(s) of inheritance in OOPs? Features: i) Sub Class ii) Super Class iii) Reusability iv) Operator Overloading
pyq.e: Sub class, super class and reusability are inheritance features; operator overloading belongs to polymorphism.

pyq.q:
What is the expected output of the following Python code?
print("\nDictionary Iteration")
d = dict()
d['lmn'] = 123
d['abc'] = 345
for i in d :
print("%s %d" %(i, d[i]))
pyq.e: Iterating a dict yields keys in insertion order, printing 'lmn 123' then 'abc 345'.

pyq.q:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?
i) A tuple is a sequence of immutable Python objects, in the given tuple course = "l", "m", "n", "o", has four elements.
ii) To explicitly remove an entire tuple, use the drop statement.
pyq.e: Statement i is true; statement ii is false because a tuple is removed with del, and Python has no drop statement.

pyq.q: Time complexity of Merge Sort Algorithm and Binary Search Algorithm are respectively ______.
o: O(log2 n) and O(n log2 n)
O(n log2 n) and O(log2 n)
pyq.e: Merge sort is O(n log n); binary search halves the range each step, O(log n).

pyq.q: Which of the following statement is false about a B- tree of order M?
o: The root has at least two child nodes and at most M child nodes.
The internal nodes except the root have at least ⌈M/2⌉ child nodes.
Leaf nodes are not at the same level.
A node is full if it has (M – 1) keys.
pyq.e: All leaves of a B-tree lie at the same level, so the claim that they do not is false.

pyq.q: Time complexity of f(x) = 4x2– 5x + 3 is:
pyq.e: Only the fastest-growing term matters, so it is O(x²).

pyq.q: Which of the following recurrence relation is related to worst case time complexity of quick sort ?
pyq.e: In the worst case the pivot splits n into 1 and n−1, giving T(n) = T(n−1) + cn, which is O(n²).

pyq.q: The minimum number of edges in a spanning tree of a connected graph with "n" vertices is:
pyq.e: A spanning tree on n vertices has exactly n−1 edges.
pyq.topic: Graphs: Representation, BFS, DFS & Spanning Trees

pyq.q: Which of the following statements is correct about the divide and conquer approach of binary search technique?
o: The best-case time complexity of binary search is O(log n).
The recurrence relation of binary search is written as T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(1), where n is the number of elements in the array.
The worst-case time complexity of binary search is O(log n).
The average-case time complexity of binary search is O(n).
pyq.e: Binary search recurrence is T(n)=T(n/2)+O(1); best case is O(1), average and worst O(log n).

pyq.q: The average number of comparisons performed in sequential search on a list of n elements is:-
pyq.e: A successful sequential search examines on average (n+1)/2 elements.

pyq.q: Which of the following SQL queries correctly returns the second-highest result from the student table?
o: SELECT result FROM student ORDER BY result DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
SELECT MAX(result) FROM student WHERE result < (SELECT MAX(result) FROM student);
SELECT result FROM student WHERE ROWNUM = 2 ORDER BY result DESC;
SELECT TOP 2 result FROM student ORDER BY result DESC;
pyq.e: Nested MAX below the overall MAX returns the second-highest distinct value; (a) repeats on ties, (c) returns nothing in Oracle, (d) returns two rows.
pyq.topic: SQL: DDL, DML, DCL, Clauses & Joins

List-I (Operator) | List-II (Definition)
1. { }: | i. optional data
2. ( ): | ii. selection
3. [, ,]: | iii. iterative
pyq.e: In data-dictionary notation { } is iteration, ( ) is optional data and [ , ] is selection: 1-iii, 2-i, 3-ii.

CID | CNAME | GAME | SALARY

G05 | YUVRAJA | CRICKET | NULL
G08 | MALKHAN | ATHLATIC S | 80000
G09 | SACINDRA | CRICKET | NULL
pyq.e: Aggregates ignore NULLs: COUNT(GAME) = 3 and AVG(SALARY) = (60000+80000)/2 = 70000.

pyq.q:
Following are the two tables in a MySQL database
Database : COMPARTMENT
Table : SUBJECTS
SUBCODE | SUBNAME | MAXT | MAXP
065 | Informatics Practices | 70 | 30
083 | Computer Science | 70 | 30
301 | English Core | 80 | 20
Table : RESULT
ROLL | SUBCODE | TMARKS | PMARKS
10045 | 083 | 70 | 30
10135 | 065 | 56 | 29
10231 | 065 | 63 | 30
10345 | 083 | 56 | 29
Select the command from the following options to display subjects (SUBNAME) and number of students registered in that subject in table RESULT.
o: SELECT SUBNAME, COUNT (*) FROM SUBJECTS, RESULT GROUP BY SUBNAME;
SELECT SUBNAME, COUNT (*) FROM SUBJECTS, RESULT ORDER BY SUBNAME;
SELECT SUBNAME, COUNT (*) FROM SUBJECTS NATURAL JOIN RESULT ORDER BY SUBNAME;
SELECT SUBNAME, COUNT (*) FROM SUBJECTS NATURAL JOIN RESULT GROUP BY SUBNAME;
pyq.e: Natural join matches rows on SUBCODE and GROUP BY SUBNAME gives the count per subject.

pyq.q:
Consider the following EMP table. Which of the following select statement should be executed if we need to display the average salary of employees who belong to grade "E4"?
EMP_NO | SALARY | GRADE
E001 | 1000 | E1
E002 | 2000 | E4
E003 | 1500 | E2
E004 | 4000 | E4
o: Select avg(salary) from EMP whose grade = "E4";
Select avg(salary) from EMP having grade = "E4";
Select avg(salary) from EMP group by grade where grade = "E4";
Select avg(salary) from EMP group by grade having grade ="E4";
pyq.e: Group by grade and use HAVING to keep only the E4 group; WHERE cannot follow GROUP BY.

Consider the following SQL query:
PROJ (Pnum, Dnum)
DEPT (Dnumber, Mgr_SSn)
EMP (fname, lname, SSn)

(SELECT DISTINCT Pnum FROM PROJ, DEPT, EMP WHERE Dnum = Dnumber AND Mgr_SSn = SSn AND Lname = 'XXXX')
UNION
(SELECT DISTINCT Pnum FROM PROJ, WORKS_ON, EMP WHERE Pnum = Pno AND ESSn = SSn AND Lname = 'XXXX')
The above query retrieves:
o: All project numbers for projects that involve an employee with last name 'XXXX', either as worker or as manager
All project numbers for projects that involve an employee with last name 'XXXX' as manager.
Records of all employees with last name as 'XXXX' working in a project as manager.
All project number for projects in department Dnumber and where 'XXXX' is involved either as worker or as manager.

pyq.q: Which of the following refers to the art of recording, classifying and summarising in a significant manner, and in terms of money, transactions and events that are in part at least of a financial character, and interpreting the results thereof?
pyq.e: Recording, classifying, summarising in money terms and interpreting the results is the definition of financial accounting; book-keeping is only recording.

pyq.q: Which of the following notation of ERD (Entity – Relationship Diagram) shows the ‘Weak Entity’?
pyq.e: A weak entity is drawn as a double rectangle; a double diamond is the identifying relationship.

ii. —O|— (line with a small circle and one bar) | b. Attributes
iii. ——|| (line with two bars) | c. Optional one
iv. Diamond | d. Mandatory one
pyq.e: Oval = attribute, circle+bar = optional one, two bars = mandatory one, diamond = relationship: i-b, ii-c, iii-d, iv-a.

pyq.q: If X1, X2, X3,..., XN are the domains in a relational database model, then the relation (table) is a subset of which of the following?
pyq.e: A relation is a subset of the Cartesian product of its domains.

Table | Degree | Cardinality
STUDENT | 20 | 300
TEACHER | 10 | 25
Select the degree and cardinality of the Cartesian product of the tables STUDENT × TEACHER from the following options :
pyq.e: Degrees add (20+10 = 30) and cardinalities multiply (300×25 = 7500).

pyq.q: In the TEARDOWN state of the Real Time Streaming Protocol, ______
o: The server frees resources for client
Server delivers the stream to client
pyq.e: TEARDOWN ends the RTSP session; the exam key takes breaking down the connection as the defining action (freeing resources is also defensible per RFC 2326).

pyq.q: A high-speed communication equipment typically would not be needed for
o: Supporting communication between nodes in a LAN
More than one of the above
pyq.e: E-mail messages are small and delay-tolerant; bulk transfer and LAN communication need high speed.
pyq.topic: Application Layer Protocols (HTTP, DNS, FTP, SMTP)

pyq.q: Any time you include JavaScript verbiage in HTML document, you must enclose those lines inside a ______ tag pair.
pyq.e: JavaScript must be enclosed in a script element so the browser treats it as code.

pyq.e: The anchor element with an href creates a link to another page; <link> is for stylesheets.

This is link to write me an email

pyq.e: JavaScript goes inside script tags.

o: JavaScript is the scripting standard for HTML
DHTML is the art of combining HTML, JavaScript, DOM, and CSS
DHTML is a term used to describe the technologies used to make web pages dynamic and interactive
pyq.e: DHTML is a combination of HTML, CSS, DOM and JavaScript, not a language itself.

pyq.q: How do you comment a single line in PHP?
pyq.e: Two slashes begin a single-line comment in PHP.

pyq.q: To declare the version of XML. the correct syntax is :
pyq.e: The declaration begins with '<?xml' and quotes the version; (b) is the best of the four (strictly it should close with '?>').

pyq.q: The normal form of the matrix M = [[1,1,0,−2],[2,0,2,2],[4,1,3,1]] is _____.
pyq.e: R3 = R1 + (3/2)R2, so the rank is 2 and the normal form is the 2×2 identity in the top-left corner with zeros elsewhere.

pyq.q: The series Σ 1/∛(n²) is:
pyq.e: The term is 1/n^(2/3), a p-series with p = 2/3 ≤ 1, so it diverges. The official key gives (d), which is incorrect.

pyq.q: The particular solution of the differential equation (D⁴ − 18D² + 81)y = 72e³ˣ is ________ .
pyq.e: (D−3)²(D+3)²y: root 3 has multiplicity 2, so PI = 72x²e³ˣ/[2!·(6)²] = x²e³ˣ.

pyq.q: Which of the following options is the particular solution of the differential equation y″ − 6y′ + 9y = 2e³ᵗ?
pyq.e: The auxiliary equation (m−3)² = 0 has a double root 3, so PI = 2·t²e³ᵗ/2! = t²e³ᵗ.
